scripts.ingest:bootstrap: npm run db:migrate && tsx scripts/ingest-catalog.ts && tsx scripts/ingest-jp.ts && tsx scripts/ingest-prices.ts && tsx scripts/seed-contents.ts && tsx scripts/enrich-logos.ts && tsx scripts/backfill-history.ts && tsx scripts/compute-chase.ts
